blueprints.depicts: Clean line drawing titled 'Porsche 901 (1963)': steel wheels with hub caps, slim chrome bumpers with overriders, rear exhaust visible, door mirror on the wing, fuel filler lid on the left front wing.
blueprints.accuracy_notes: Measured WB/L = 0.542 (auto-detected wheels, verified overlay). SWB drawings that print their own dimensions (the-blueprints vector preview 'Porsche 911 (1967)': 2211 / 4163 mm; Autocar 1966: 7 ft 3.5 in / 13 ft 8 in) give 0.531-0.534, so this drawing's wheelbase is ~2% long relative to its length (same contributor's later side drawings 64516/64517 are badly distorted, see those stops). Scale it by the wheelbase and re-check overhangs against ../02 factory drawing.
blueprints.ratio_check_vs_official: measured WB/L 0.542 vs official 2204/4135 mm = 0.533 -> +1.7% : close (1-2%)

measurement_method: measured_wb_over_len = wheelbase / overall length measured in pixels on the side view (hub centres, bumper extremes); wheels auto-detected with OpenCV HoughCircles and checked on an overlay, or read manually from a 10-px gridded zoom. Typical uncertainty +/-1% (large drawings) to +/-2% (small/low-res). Compare with the sourced dimensions in ../../geometry.json.
